column1: # The level sweep, recorded from Homebrew's zstd CLI v1.5.7 on 2026-10-16 for
# docs/AUDIT-third-party-2026-10-15.md ZC.6: the frames the ZC.4 differential
# had libzstd's encoder write at run time, made once and kept, so the
# differential runs with no libzstd in the graph. sweep-zstd-1.5.7.zst holds
# every frame back to back; each row says where one lies, the input it was
# made from (tests/support `input(spec)` regenerates it), the command that
# wrote it, and the length and SHA-256 of what `zstd -dc` decodes it to,
# checked equal to the input's own when recorded.
# The plan: at every level from --fast=5 to --ultra -22, a 1,536-byte words
# input, a 2,048-byte inserts input in 1 KiB blocks (`--zstd=wlog=10`), a
# 140,000-byte run and the four bytes `zstd`; a 3,072-byte words input in
# 1 KiB blocks at -3, 6, 12 and 22, `one_code` (RLE tables whose codes carry
# extra bits) at 5, 12 and 19, `rle_literals` at 6, 13 and 19; then words at
# every Frame_Content_Size edge up to 1,025 bytes and `sparse` across the
# block size, at levels -3, 1, 7 and 19 in turn. Checksum and content size
# (a file input declares its size, a pipe does not) turn per level, so each
